category_title: Students who engage in disruptive behaviors to avoid nonpreferred writing tasks
scenario_title: Independent writing assignment with specified components
minimal_context: Mike is at his desk in the second-grade classroom during independent writing time, tasked with writing a paragraph containing a starter sentence, detail sentences, and a conclusion statement.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for independent writing. Please begin working on your assignment, making sure to include your starter sentence, detail sentences, and a conclusion statement.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Mike picks up his pencil and begins loudly tapping it on his desk, looking around the room instead of at his paper.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Mike, please stop tapping and get to work on your writing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Mike gets out of his seat without permission and walks across the room to the pencil sharpener.) I need to sharpen my pencil again.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You just sharpened it. Please sit back down and write your starter sentence.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Mike walks back to his group but does not sit down. He leans over, tapping the student next to him on the shoulder while they are working, and calls out across the room) Hey, what are you writing? I don't want to do this!

task.content: Independent writing exercises including specified writing components (i.e., starter sentence, detail sentences, conclusion statement)
task.learning_goal: Completing the assigned activity within the time provided

context.materials: Task materials, pencil, objects on his desk, environmental support to visually cue expectations
context.social_setting: Independent work times with other students present and working

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When Mike is presented with demands to start academic tasks that are less preferred, especially tasks during independent and large group work times
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Tapping objects on his desk, calling out without permission, tapping other students on the shoulders when they were working, getting out of his seat without permission, and sharpening his pencil more than once
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Will engage in disruptive behavior to delay or avoid the nonpreferred academic activity

behavior_patterns.condition: During assigned activities and independent work tasks, specifically writing
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Tapping objects on his desk, calling out without permission, tapping other students on the shoulders when they were working, getting out of his seat without permission, and sharpening his pencil more than once
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Desires to delay or avoid the nonpreferred academic activity
